answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake in escrow that is slashed if its attestations are later proven false. New identities start with a tiny trust budget, like a jetty that only lets small boats dock, so they can only co-sign low-value work until correct seals accumulate. Good history builds an oasis of trust around an identity, while a fake peer that vouches for many Sybils is frozen out like a glacier: its stake burns and its seals lose value. An attacker must fund each fake separately, pay stake each time, and lose it all when one link is exposed, making Sybil creation expensive.
